results: 1. skin examination: a painless, non-pruritic confluent erythematous rash on the left arm one day before the chorea began; it improved with doxycycline and clindamycin but the chorea did not
2. autoimmune encephalopathy / paraneoplastic antibody panel: NEGATIVE in serum and CSF - seronegative
3. brain MRI with contrast: 1.5T with gadolinium - frontal-predominant atrophy but NO focal lesion, with normal basal ganglia structure and volume
4. PET-CT or CT body (occult malignancy): skull base to thighs - no malignancy and no infection
5. trial of immunotherapy: empirical IVIg produced DRAMATIC improvement of the hemichorea - the diagnosis rests on the treatment response
